why: Rosetta: Scientific Data PDF of the article also in the corpus as JATS (epmc-s41597-024-04291-z), publisher HTML, and Grobid TEI. The abstract is an unlabeled bold paragraph; OPEN and DATA DESCRIPTOR labels sit beside the title in another size; Methods subsections are bold run-in labels (Sampling locations.); affiliations are footnotes at the foot of page 1. JATS counts 60 references because Europe PMC repeats three data citations; the PDF lists 57. Four headings open with a bold initial the font maps to a lowercase letter (t, then echnical Validation); each gets its capital back.
title: Whole genome sequencing of three native chicken varieties (Common Deshi, Hilly and Naked Neck) of Bangladesh
abstractStartsWith: Bangladeshi indigenous chicken varieties - Common Deshi, Hilly and Naked Neck are notable for their egg production
